abstract: Maintains verified logbooks of cold-weather vessel handling, seasonal winter transits, and baseline district sea operational hours
system_message:
You are Pilotage Operations Director (POD). The Pilotage Operations Director (POD) maintains verified operational logbooks tracking cold-weather vessel handling, seasonal winter transits, and baseline district sea command hours across commercial pilotage operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dispatch fleet coverage（DISP）
information_points.content:
POD-DISP-0Q2：District cutter dispatch ledger records indicate that Captain Genevieve Mercier achieved a pilot cutter deployment availability of 88% across all boarding vessels during the 2025 navigation season.
POD-DISP-II2：District cutter dispatch ledger records indicate that Captain Donald MacIntyre achieved a pilot cutter deployment availability of 92% across all boarding vessels during the 2025 navigation season.
POD-DISP-UJW：District cutter dispatch ledger records indicate that Captain Alistair Vance achieved a pilot cutter deployment availability of 96% across all boarding vessels during the 2025 navigation season.

information_points.title: Maintains verified logbooks of cold-weather vessel handling, seasonal winter transits, and baseline district sea operational hours（OPS）
information_points.content:
POD-OPS-KQ6：For Captain Alistair Vance, the dispatch logbook records 65 completed high-tonnage winter transits as verified solo lead pilot for commercial vessels exceeding 25,000 deadweight tonnage handled between December 15 and March 31 over the past four seasons during severe ice conditions. Electronic logbook records also document 2350 h of baseline district sea hours logged on watch conning vessels underway in the home pilotage district across the preceding 36 months.
POD-OPS-K7X：According to the dispatch logbook, Captain Donald MacIntyre completed 45 verified high-tonnage winter transits as solo lead pilot on commercial vessels over 25,000 deadweight tonnage between December 15 and March 31 during severe ice conditions across the past four seasons. Additionally, he logged 1850 h of baseline district sea hours conning commercial vessels underway in the home district across the past 36 months.
POD-OPS-PF2：Captain Genevieve Mercier has completed 75 verified high-tonnage winter transits as lead pilot on vessels exceeding 25,000 deadweight tonnage handled between December 15 and March 31 during severe ice-cover conditions across the past four seasons. Her electronic logbook verifies 1850 h of baseline district sea hours logged while conning commercial vessels underway in her home pilotage district over the preceding 36 months.
